_comment: Parcel-geometry wedges. These move the two 0-built arbitrages (relationship, development) off zero using ONLY the parcel layer we already have -- adjacency, road frontage, zoning, lot area, existing units. No external data, no paywall. relationship_value_access finds parcels worth disproportionately more to one specific neighbor (the essence of Relationship arbitrage). hidden_density_zoning_mismatch finds parcels zoned for far more than what's built (Development arbitrage). Both are derived inferences from geometry/zoning fields, so they're marked lower-reliability -- a lift, not hard evidence.

relationship_value_access.note: a parcel with no road frontage whose access crosses a specific neighbor is worth far more to that neighbor than to the open market -- a natural buyer exists, so a deal is unusually doable

assemblage.note: an owner buying up contiguous parcels (>=2 adjacent, at least one a recent acquisition) is an active assembler; the still-independent parcels touching that block are the natural next targets -- worth more to that specific buyer (relationship) and part of a redevelopment play (development)

hidden_density.note: zoning-implied max units minus existing units; a large gap = redevelopment/infill upside the parcel record doesn't advertise
